_note: PROVISIONAL prototype values. Not confirmed design; all must stay configurable. See docs/provisional-values.md.

stats._note: PROVISIONAL: how the four attributes (might, dexterity, agility, vitality) become battle numbers. Armor comes from gear only (later), so it is not here.

progression._note: PROVISIONAL and switched OFF: while disabled every character fights at level 1 with its class attributes. xp_to_level[i] = total XP to reach level i+2.

items._note: PROVISIONAL: how many different kinds of item a character brings into a battle.

rewards._note: PROVISIONAL XP: participation plus a victory bonus.
